The OSMAIN verse 13 contains two distinct thoughts: (A) God defending the poor/afflicted and (B) The righteous praising God. The TRANSLATION splits these into verses 13 and 14.
This verse contains the second half of OSMAIN verse 13 ('Sannelig, de rettferdige skal prise ditt navn...'). It is not an extra verse in content, but a split of the source text.
